svg.title: Indian Equatorial Undercurrent - spring reference reach: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 4200 km. Declared53 E to91 E spring Indian EUC reference corridor. Longitude gates follow the reviewed 1963 observational domain; OSW chooses the equatorial line, connecting vertices and alternatives. Excludes Wyrtki surface jets, westward undercurrent conventions, anomalous fall episodes and whole-basin endpoints. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate spring observational-domain reference reach — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
